name: ascon_primas
author: Robert Primas (TU Graz)
preprocessing: sv2v v0.0.13: sv2v -I src/rtl -DV1 src/rtl/ascon_core.sv > conv/ascon_core_v1.v (Yosys 0.33 rejects multi-dim packed arrays in asconp.sv:28)
protocol: AEAD128-ENC, 16-byte AD, 16-byte PT; fixed 75-cycle control vector (check/ascon_aead128enc_ad16_pt16_v1.csv); key words consumed cycles 1-4, nonce 5-8, AD 22-25, PT 44-47 (CT on bdo same cycles), tag on bdo 71-74
reference: pyascon (ascon.py) + cocotb test.py in repo; our iverilog TB: 5/5 random (key,nonce,AD,PT) match pyascon on RTL and on the synthesized iCE40 netlist
risks: SystemVerilog (needs sv2v); async active-high reset (SB_DFFR/SB_DFFER); FSM handshake inputs must follow the recorded control vector; 3762 LUT4 near upper end

name: oc_present
author: Reza Ameli (Ferdowsi Univ. of Mashhad), via OpenCores/freecores
protocol: c0 key_load=1 (data_i=key); c1 data_load=1 (data_i[63:0]=plaintext); c2-c32 idle (data_i don't-care); ciphertext on data_o during c0 of the next period
reference: repo tb/testbench.v (4 PRESENT-paper vectors, all reproduced); our strictly periodic TB: 10/10 random vectors vs Python PRESENT-80, RTL and gate-level
risks: no reset pin (round_counter set by data_load); key register is overwritten by the key schedule so key_load is part of every transaction

name: oc_sha_core:sha1
author: marsgod (OpenCores sha_core)
license: OpenCores BSD-style notice (use/distribute with copyright notice; no warranty)
protocol: c0 cmd_w_i=1 cmd_i=3'b010 (first block; 3'b110 = continuation); c1-c16 text_i=W0..W15; busy until c83; c84 cmd_w_i=1 cmd_i=3'b001 (read); digest words H0..H4 sampled on text_o at c87-c91
reference: repo bench/test_sha1.v fails under Icarus (TB drives inputs on the clock edge; race). Our race-free TB: 5/5 random single-block messages match hashlib.sha1 with the fixed 92-cycle schedule, RTL and gate-level
risks: repo testbench racy; 32-bit streaming input (data read only in cycles c1-c16)

name: adi_fir_decim
category: folded DSP (polyphase decimating FIR, one pre-add/MAC)
author: Analog Devices Inc. (hdl library)
license: GPL-2.0 or ADI-BSD (dual, per file header)
preprocessing: chparam -set USE_DSP48E 0 fir_decim (selects the author's generic MAC branch instead of a DSP48E1 instance)
protocol: reset 1+ cycles; clk_enable=1 every 5th cycle (one input sample per 5 cycles); one output (ce_out pulse, filter_out) per 2 samples = 10 cycles
reference: no repo testbench (MATLAB m2k_decim.m only). Our check: least-squares fit over 300 random samples gives an exact (residual 0) decimate-by-2 FIR h=[213,-962,1778,1778,-962,213]; gate-level output identical to RTL
risks: storage0/1 bit-serial shift memories with initial values; requires USE_DSP48E=0 override

name: ettus_hbdec:small_hb_dec
author: Ettus Research (UHD FPGA, usrp2 sdr_lib)
preprocessing: none (MULT18X18S behavioural model is Ettus' own GPL file in fpga/usrp2/models)
protocol: bypass=0, run=1; rst=1 for 20 cycles (RTL sim needs it to flush unreset registers); stb_in=1 one cycle in every 4; one output (stb_out) per 2 inputs = 8 cycles
reference: repo hb_dec_tb.v drives small_hb_dec from input.dat (not run by us). Our impulse test reproduces taps [A,B,B,A]=[-2672,18952,18952,-2672]/65536 and centre 0.5; gate-level identical to RTL
risks: round_sd error-feedback rounding (stateful, non-linear); several registers without reset

name: ibex_multdiv_slow
category: iterative arithmetic (radix-2 multiplier/divider, shared ALU adder)
author: lowRISC (Ibex RISC-V core)
preprocessing: sv2v v0.0.13 -DSYNTHESIS -DYOSYS -> conv/ibex_md_top.v; wrapper adds the two 34-bit imd_val registers that ibex_id_stage.sv:445-452 normally provides and ties off ALU/branch inputs
protocol: data_ind_timing_i=1; fix md_op_i/signed_mode_i per run; hold mult_en_i (MUL) or div_en_i (DIV) at 1; change op_a_i/op_b_i every 33 (MUL) or 37 (DIV) cycles; valid_o once per period at a fixed offset
reference: RISC-V M semantics; our TB: 200 handshake ops + 60 strictly periodic ops (incl. div-by-0, INT_MIN/-1) match a Python model, RTL and gate-level
risks: needs sv2v and a 30-line wrapper (imd_val registers live in ibex_id_stage upstream); with data_ind_timing_i=0 MUL and div-by-zero exit early (ibex_multdiv_slow.sv:194,210,222,255) - must be tied to 1

name: bambu_arf
author: Bambu HLS (PandA, Politecnico di Milano) generating the ARF benchmark (Jain 1989 / Mukherjee 1996) from PandA example arf_res_sharing
license: input C: PandA-bambu repo (GPL-3.0); generated library components tagged PANDA_LGPLv3
preprocessing: Bambu 2024.10 AppImage (revision c2ba6936): bambu module.c --top-fname=arf constraints_ui_mult1.xml --generate-interface=INFER (constraint limits ui_mult_expr_FU to 1; the upstream XML names mult_expr_FU, which no longer binds because 2024.10 canonicalises the products to unsigned)
parameters: 1 multiplier, 11 shared registers (Bambu: 11 registers, LB 6), 15 states
protocol: reset (active-low) then start_port=1 for one cycle every 16 cycles; inputs held for the whole period (read in several states); o1..o4 are combinational and valid only when o*_vld (offsets 3,1,12,13); done_port at offset 13 (15-cycle latency per Bambu)
reference: C source in repo; our TB: 20 handshake + 20 periodic vectors match the C semantics (32-bit wrap), RTL and gate-level
risks: tool-generated (Bambu version must be cited); G3/G4 unused; outputs not registered

name: oc_fixedpoint:qdiv
author: Tom Burke (extending Sam Skalicky), OpenCores/freecores
protocol: i_start=1 one cycle every 48 cycles; operands sampled only at start; o_complete rises 47 cycles later
reference: repo TestDiv*.v (not run). Our check: 100 handshake + 20 periodic random divisions; output equals the ideal Q15 quotient with bit 0 forced to 0 (upstream defect: reg_quotient is copied before the last quotient bit is set, qdiv.v:92-99); ideal division mismatches 52/100. Gate-level identical to RTL
risks: no reset (initial values; iCE40 power-up semantics); LSB defect documented above

protocol: init=1 one cycle, outputs valid 16 cycles later; init also asynchronously clears the iteration counter
reference: repo tb_cordic.v (91 angles); with patches max |error| 2.6e-4 vs math.sin/cos
risks: no explicit license; init used as async reset of iteration counter; needs two source patches
